_readme: The points pool. Every bullet you could ever put on a CV lives here exactly once.
roleId      which role in profile.json this bullet sits under
variants    same underlying fact, re-angled for a different audience.
NEVER put a new claim in a variant - only a rewording.
tags        from data/taxonomy.json - this drives JD matching
strength    1-5, your own view of how impressive it is. Ties break on this.
inMaster    true if it appears on the 2026 master CV
Keep every number here defensible in an interview.

points.text: President, Fintech & Blockchain Club | GMAT Focus: 695

variants.label: leadership-forward
variants.text: President, Fintech & Blockchain Club (largest student club by membership) | GMAT Focus: 695

variants.label: academics-forward
variants.text: GMAT Focus: 695 | President, Fintech & Blockchain Club

points.notes: Effectively always included - it is the only INSEAD bullet.

points.text: Mentored junior students, directly achieving a 10% rise in average GPA through individualised academic support and mentorship

variants.label: people-forward
variants.text: Coached junior students one-to-one, lifting their average GPA 10% through individualised academic support

variants.label: short
variants.text: Raised mentees' average GPA 10% through one-to-one academic coaching of junior students

points.text: Served as Workshop Head for the annual college festival Ignus, generating $10K in revenue through strategic partnerships and sales

variants.label: commercial-forward
variants.text: Generated $10K in revenue as Workshop Head of the annual college festival Ignus by securing corporate partnerships and driving delegate sales

variants.label: ops-forward
variants.text: As Workshop Head for the annual college festival Ignus, delivered $10K in revenue by securing partnerships and driving sales

points.text: Developed the product roadmap for a bootstrapped renovation-investment platform, defining 20+ core features using AI-driven research

variants.label: ai-forward
variants.text: Used AI-driven research to define 20+ core features and build the product roadmap for a bootstrapped renovation-investment platform

variants.label: zero-to-one
variants.text: Built the product roadmap for a bootstrapped renovation-investment platform from a blank page, defining 20+ core features through AI-driven market and user research

points.notes: Strongest 'I do product' signal on the CV. Lead with it for PM roles.

points.text: Owned compliance research and product strategy for a lean founding team, shaping a platform targeting up to 16% annual returns

variants.label: ops-forward
variants.text: Owned regulatory and compliance research end-to-end for a lean founding team, translating findings into product requirements for a platform targeting up to 16% annual returns

variants.label: ambiguity-forward
variants.text: Operated with no playbook on a lean founding team, owning compliance research and product strategy for a platform targeting up to 16% annual returns

points.notes: Best bullet for regulated industries - fintech, banking, insurance, marketplaces.

points.text: Optimised development workflow with AI tooling and JIRA, delivering 50% fewer meetings and 20% faster product cycles

variants.label: product-ops
variants.text: Redesigned the team's development workflow around AI tooling and JIRA, cutting meetings 50% and shortening product cycles 20%

variants.label: process-forward
variants.text: Eliminated 50% of recurring meetings and shortened product cycles 20% by rebuilding the development workflow with AI tooling and JIRA

points.notes: The single best bullet for any Operations or Product Ops role.

points.text: Drove product strategy with Sales to prioritise customer-driven features, enabling $40–50M in Annual Contract Value

variants.label: customer-forward
variants.text: Partnered with Sales to translate customer needs into a prioritised feature set, enabling $40–50M in Annual Contract Value

variants.label: xfn-forward
variants.text: Aligned Sales, Product and Engineering on a single prioritised roadmap driven by customer input, enabling $40–50M in Annual Contract Value

points.notes: Biggest number on the CV. Almost always include.

points.text: Managed a team of 11+ developers and a $500K budget to deliver best-in-class migration software recognised by Gartner

variants.label: people-forward
variants.text: Led and developed a team of 11+ engineers against a $500K budget, shipping migration software recognised by Gartner as best-in-class

variants.label: delivery-forward
variants.text: Delivered Gartner-recognised migration software on a $500K budget with a team of 11+ developers

variants.label: budget-forward
variants.text: Ran a $500K budget and an 11+ person team to deliver migration software Gartner rated best-in-class

points.notes: The people-management proof point. Include for anything with reports or budget.

points.text: Spearheaded the creation of a files migration feature, led cross-organisational collaboration to onboard customers with 10+ petabytes of data, resulting in $1M+ in recurring revenue

variants.label: grammar-fixed
variants.text: Spearheaded a new files migration capability and led cross-organisational collaboration to onboard customers with 10+ petabytes of data, generating $1M+ in recurring revenue

variants.label: customer-forward
variants.text: Onboarded enterprise customers holding 10+ petabytes of data onto a new files migration capability, unlocking $1M+ in recurring revenue

points.notes: Corrected in place (was 'lead'/'resulting $1M+'). The 'grammar-fixed' variant is retained as an alias.

points.text: Introduced initiatives to establish coding standards, resulting in a 30% improvement in code quality and fewer customer defects

variants.label: process-forward
variants.text: Established team-wide coding standards and review practices, improving code quality 30% and reducing customer-reported defects

variants.label: quality-forward
variants.text: Drove a 30% improvement in code quality and a drop in customer-reported defects by introducing team-wide coding standards

points.notes: Weakest Nutanix bullet - first to cut when space is tight.

points.text: Revamped the checkout process, saving customers 30 seconds per checkout; optimisation led to an improved Customer Conversion Rate, reduced Cart Abandonment, and increased Average Order Value for a global customer base

variants.label: short
variants.text: Revamped the checkout flow to save 30 seconds per purchase, lifting Conversion Rate and Average Order Value while reducing Cart Abandonment across a global customer base

variants.label: metrics-forward
variants.text: Improved Conversion Rate and Average Order Value and cut Cart Abandonment for a global customer base by rebuilding checkout to save 30 seconds per purchase

variants.label: ops-forward
variants.text: Removed 30 seconds of friction per checkout by rebuilding the flow, improving Conversion Rate and Average Order Value and cutting Cart Abandonment for a global customer base

points.notes: The e-commerce / consumer-funnel bullet. Essential for marketplace, payments, retail, growth roles. Long - use 'short' variant when space is tight.

points.text: Drove business expansion by collaborating with the Product team to identify and launch a new e-commerce platform feature, establishing a new revenue stream of $25K+/month, rolled out across United Kingdom

variants.label: short
variants.text: Identified and launched a new e-commerce feature with the Product team, opening a $25K+/month revenue stream across the United Kingdom

variants.label: revenue-forward
variants.text: Opened a $25K+/month revenue stream by identifying and launching a new e-commerce platform feature with the Product team, rolled out across the United Kingdom

points.text: Architected the foundational blockchain MVP and strategic product roadmap as a founding member, while establishing the core cultural values and operational standards required to scale the technical organisation

variants.label: short
variants.text: Architected the foundational blockchain MVP and product roadmap as a founding member, setting the cultural values and operational standards used to scale the technical organisation

variants.label: zero-to-one
variants.text: Took a blockchain platform from zero to MVP as a founding member, owning the technical architecture, product roadmap, and the operating standards the organisation scaled on

points.notes: The startup / 0-to-1 credibility bullet. Lead with it for early-stage companies.

points.text: Led a 10+ member team to develop multiple differentiating features for the Eleven01 blockchain, culminating in an Initial Coin Offering

variants.label: grammar-fixed
variants.text: Led a 10+ member team to build the differentiating features of the Eleven01 blockchain, culminating in an Initial Coin Offering

variants.label: people-forward
variants.text: Led a 10+ member team through the build of the Eleven01 blockchain's differentiating features, culminating in an Initial Coin Offering

variants.label: launch-forward
variants.text: Shipped the differentiating features of the Eleven01 blockchain with a 10+ member team, culminating in an Initial Coin Offering

points.notes: Corrected in place (was 'a Initial'). The 'grammar-fixed' variant is retained as an alias.

points.text: Boosted footfall and sales for brick-and-mortar retailers by 10% by developing an iOS app; sending hyper-local and personalised offers to users within a shopping mall

variants.label: short
variants.text: Lifted footfall and sales 10% for brick-and-mortar retailers by building an iOS app that pushed hyper-local, personalised offers to shoppers inside a mall

variants.label: growth-forward
variants.text: Drove a 10% lift in footfall and sales for brick-and-mortar retailers with an iOS app delivering hyper-local, personalised offers to shoppers in-mall

points.notes: Note: this bullet sits under Amantya (a 5G/IoT telecom firm) while the IoT-deployment bullet sits under Cognizant. Worth double-checking they are not swapped.

points.text: Built automation to bring down platform deployment time of complex IoT solution from 5–6 days to 1 hour by leading a cross-team initiative to build a deployment platform

variants.label: short
variants.text: Cut deployment time for a complex IoT solution from 5–6 days to 1 hour by leading a cross-team initiative to build a deployment automation platform

variants.label: ops-forward
variants.text: Led a cross-team initiative that automated platform deployment for a complex IoT solution, collapsing a 5-6 day manual process into 1 hour

points.notes: Strong efficiency/automation number. Great for ops roles. 'IOT' corrected to 'IoT'.

points.text: Defined the AI-first operating model for a founding team, up and running in 2 months instead of 6 and reaching a demo product and investor conversations far sooner

variants.label: short
variants.text: Stood up an AI-first operating model in 2 months instead of 6, reaching a demo product and investor conversations far sooner

variants.label: ops-forward
variants.text: Built the operating model that lets non-technical founders run engineering — progress tracked in Notion, requests raised in Linear, delivery by AI coding agents — cutting setup from 6 months to 2

variants.label: investor-forward
variants.text: Cut the team's path to a demo product and investor conversations from 6 months to 2 by designing an AI-first operating model around Notion, Linear and AI coding agents

points.notes: Default is 2 lines by choice - the fuller "Defined... for a founding team" opening is preferred over the terser one-liner. Use the "short" variant (1 line) when the page is tight. COLLIDES with nutanix-ai-workflow (AI tooling -> faster delivery): "operating model / founding team / investors" vs Nutanix "optimized an existing workflow, 50%/20%" is what keeps them distinct. Avoid "operational standards" here - that belongs to eleven01-mvp.

points.text: Traced an 18% rise in fleet operating cost against 0% revenue growth to its underlying drivers, building the financial analysis that framed the cost problem

variants.label: short
variants.text: Traced an 18% rise in fleet operating cost against 0% revenue growth to its underlying drivers

variants.label: analysis-forward
variants.text: Ran the financial analysis isolating why fleet operating cost rose 18% while revenue stayed flat, naming each underlying driver

variants.label: cursor-forward
variants.text: Traced an 18% rise in fleet operating cost against 0% revenue growth to its underlying drivers, building the financial analysis in Cursor

points.notes: The only point covering data-analysis and pricing — both were zero-coverage gaps, and data-analysis was the top ask in the Product Ops JD. Almost always include. 'cursor-forward' names the tool: Parag confirmed on 2026-09-02 that the financial analysis was run in Cursor. Same finding as the base text, one line, no new number - use it where AI fluency is being signalled, the same way valeo-route-app uses 'ai-forward'.

points.text: Developed two strategies to cut fleet cost by up to 30%: consolidating the two verticals and building a three-hub network that shortens the distance driven per order

variants.label: short
variants.text: Developed two strategies to cut fleet cost by up to 30%, including a three-hub network that shortens distance driven per order

variants.label: consulting-forward
variants.text: Sized two levers to cut fleet cost by up to 30% — merging the two verticals and moving to a three-hub network — against the measured cost drivers

variants.label: cursor-forward
variants.text: Developed two strategies to cut fleet cost by up to 30%: consolidating the two verticals and building a three-hub network that shortens the distance driven per order, sizing the saving from each in Cursor

points.notes: Pairs naturally with valeo-cost-diagnosis (diagnosis then recommendation). Phrased as proposed, not delivered - keep it that way unless the saving has actually landed. 'cursor-forward' is the base text verbatim plus the sizing method: Parag confirmed on 2026-09-02 that the saving from each strategy was sized in Cursor. Still 2 lines, still phrased as proposed rather than delivered.

points.text: Learned how the operation ran from the people running it, then specified and prototyped the route-optimisation app they needed — 100% adoption in one week

variants.label: ai-forward
variants.text: Specified and prototyped the route-optimisation app the operations team needed, building it end-to-end with AI, reaching 100% adoption in one week

variants.label: short
variants.text: Prototyped a route-optimisation app with the operations team and drove it to 100% adoption in one week

variants.label: adoption-forward
variants.text: Drove a route-optimisation app to 100% adoption by the operations team within one week of putting the prototype in their hands

variants.label: digitisation-forward
variants.text: Digitised fleet operations with a route-optimisation app specified alongside the operations team, reaching 100% adoption within one week

points.notes: The discovery -> spec -> prototype -> adoption story, and the only point proving a tool actually landed with users. Overlaps everhaus-roadmap and touchnote-new-revenue on product tags but shares no wording with either - different stories, safe to run together. Naming the ops team size ("all N dispatchers") would make the 100% land harder. 'ai-forward' names the AI build method — use where AI fluency is being signalled.
